title: Evidence
description: A captured observation. Every finding, fix and completion claim must point at evidence, and evidence is always of what a machine actually received, never of source code.

captured_by.description: Tool or runtime that captured it, so the capture can be repeated.

hash.description: Content hash of the stored artefact, so tampering is detectable.

excerpt.description: The specific passage that supports the claim. Not the whole document.

artefact_ref.description: Pointer to the full stored capture.
